- facts (000010DD): same age as 幸太郎 and サクラ; saw サクラ's bullying in his second middle-school year and kept silent under threat; in the spring of his third year read the 蔵書 (セレ = 新村儀之助, ドローガ from 荒田's cherries), boiled the 新村本家 cherry roots three days in the cave under the secret base, smoked the crystals; crushed a stone, cracked the rock wall, broke his own leg open; his blood over サクラ in the dark, narrow cave; months in hospital, a lasting limp; サクラ's cover story "木から落ちた"; left 荒田 for a high school in 元木町, 佐波県, asking his mother not to tell サクラ

- facts (000010F5, サクラ's narration): married 美冬ちゃん, "美人で甲斐甲斐しい素敵な人", visited 荒田 now and then; died two years before 790 in an accident (8:109-112); 幸太郎 believes he made ドローガ and that his blood gave サクラ her foresight (8:323-331); 美冬 in 00001124:8:229-231: both she and he lacked confidence when they met
- 0000119C:8:221-234 (五島's theory): the voice Natsumi calls "新村栄一郎さんの声" comes from a 『何者か』 imitating him, since the dead do not speak (theory only)

- chunk-18 additions (as of 00000FCF): per Haruka's narration, clumsy: broke his leg hunting, died falling from a tree (00000F40:11:46-47); decided to marry Mifuyu the day after meeting (11:38); father of the stillborn あやか (00000FB7:11:51); Goto doubts that his voice on the wind is a dead man's (00000F9F:11:102-109); the closing bare cells of 00000FCF: "そうだね母さん。後はみんなに任せよう。" / "もう、僕たちがでしゃばる必要はない。" (47:1-2), a voice addressed 栄一郎 at 47:0 (V425)
